title: Botanical Memory
description: A made-to-measure shade that carries a personal textile — a wedding dress, a grandmother's tablecloth, a favourite scarf — set against turned oak.

images.alt: Personal textile detail in the shade
Botanical Memory lamp in an interior

accordions.title: Craftsmanship
accordions.body: We begin with a conversation about the textile and the room. The shade is then built by hand around your material, with a linen backing for a warm, even light.

accordions.title: Origin & materials
accordions.body: Your own textile, paired with Dutch oak, vegetable-tanned leather and brass fittings. Every commission includes a digital proof before production.
